pages.quiz:
GERMAN — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #20
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: GERMAN
TIME ALLOWED: 120 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What does "montags" mean in the tongue twister about the mother? (1 mark)
   A. every morning
   B. on Sundays
   C. tomorrow
   D. on Mondays

2. What does "das Radio" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. window
   B. table
   C. radio
   D. shower

3. What does "der Garten" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. garden
   B. sofa
   C. toilet
   D. house

4. Which day comes right after Dienstag? (1 mark)
   A. Mittwoch
   B. Montag
   C. Samstag
   D. Freitag

5. What does "der Tag" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. Tuesday
   B. Saturday
   C. Monday
   D. day

6. What does "gestern" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. tomorrow
   B. often
   C. yesterday
   D. always

7. What does "Was isst du gern?" ask? (1 mark)
   A. What do you like to eat?
   B. Where do you eat?
   C. When do you eat?
   D. Who eats?

8. What does "die Milch" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. carrot
   B. milk
   C. cocoa
   D. mango

9. Which sentence means "I like eating bananas"? (1 mark)
   A. Ich koche Bananen.
   B. Ich trinke gern Bananen.
   C. Ich esse keine Bananen.
   D. Ich esse gern Bananen.

10. What does "manchmal" mean? (1 mark)
   A. never
   B. always
   C. often
   D. sometimes

11. What does "der Regen" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. wind
   B. rain
   C. snow
   D. cloud

12. What does "Wie heißt du?" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. sorry, excuse me
   B. see you soon
   C. What is your name?
   D. please

13. What does "Danke" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. thank you
   B. goodbye
   C. hello (friendly)
   D. good morning

14. Which word has the sound "ow" as in "cow"? (1 mark)
   A. nein
   B. Haus
   C. Tier
   D. heute

15. What does "das Kind" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. brother
   B. child
   C. father
   D. uncle

16. What should your voice do at a full stop? (1 mark)
   A. Go up
   B. Whisper
   C. Speed up
   D. Go down and stop

17. Which little word goes with the noun "Schlafzimmer"? (1 mark)
   A. das
   B. die
   C. der
   D. den

18. How many German days of the week end in -tag? (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 4
   C. 6
   D. 5

19. What does "die Woche" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. week
   B. Thursday
   C. Wednesday
   D. Friday

20. What does "zusammen" mean? (1 mark)
   A. together
   B. never
   C. always
   D. later

21. Which German word is the number 20? (1 mark)
   A. drei
   B. zwölf
   C. zwanzig
   D. achtzehn

22. What does "sehen" mean? (1 mark)
   A. to hear
   B. to speak
   C. to eat
   D. to see

23. What does "die Schulter" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. face
   B. shoulder
   C. tooth
   D. toe

24. What does "der Wind" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. thunderstorm
   B. rain
   C. rainbow
   D. wind

25. What does "Was macht sie?" ask? (1 mark)
   A. Where is she?
   B. What is she doing?
   C. Who is she?
   D. How old is she?

26. Which German word means "in"? (position word) (1 mark)
   A. unter
   B. neben
   C. in
   D. vor

27. Which words are always written with a capital letter in German? (1 mark)
   A. Small words like und
   B. Nouns
   C. Adjectives
   D. Verbs

28. Which German word or phrase means "good night"? (1 mark)
   A. Hallo
   B. Ja
   C. Gute Nacht
   D. Sehr gut

29. What is the plural of "die Mutter"? (1 mark)
   A. die Muttere
   B. die Mutters
   C. die Mütter
   D. die Mutteren

30. What is the plural of "die Tür"? (1 mark)
   A. die Türe
   B. die Türen
   C. die Türs
   D. die Türer

31. Which sentence is written correctly? (1 mark)
   A. Der Tisch ist in der Kuche.
   B. Der Tisch ist im Küche.
   C. Der Tisch ist in dem Küche.
   D. Der Tisch ist in der Küche.

32. Which little word goes with the noun "Topf"? (1 mark)
   A. der
   B. die
   C. das
   D. den

33. Which German word or phrase means "Monday"? (1 mark)
   A. der Montag
   B. der Donnerstag
   C. der Samstag
   D. der Sonntag

34. Which German word means "to have a shower"? (verb) (1 mark)
   A. lernen
   B. riechen
   C. duschen
   D. hören

35. Which German word or phrase means "day"? (1 mark)
   A. der Mittwoch
   B. der Tag
   C. der Donnerstag
   D. der Sonntag

36. Which German word or phrase means "birthday"? (1 mark)
   A. der Luftballon
   B. die Kerze
   C. die Party
   D. der Geburtstag

37. What does "der achte" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. eighth
   B. seventh
   C. third
   D. tenth

38. Which German word or phrase means "egg"? (1 mark)
   A. das Ei
   B. die Banane
   C. der Kakao
   D. das Mittagessen

39. Which German word or phrase means "head"? (1 mark)
   A. das Haar
   B. das Gesicht
   C. der Rücken
   D. der Kopf

40. Which little word goes with the noun "Bauch"? (1 mark)
   A. der
   B. die
   C. den
   D. das

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
41. Write the German words with der, die or das for: party, foot, head, daughter. (4 marks)

42. Give two reasons why fruit and vegetables are good for the body. (2 marks)

43. Unscramble the letters TAGFIRE to make a day of the week. (2 marks)

44. Write the German words with der, die or das for: tummy, apple, cheese. (3 marks)

45. Write the German words with der, die or das for: sugar, child, sofa. (3 marks)

46. Unscramble and write with der, die or das: NUMD and ESAN. (4 marks)

47. Write the four punctuation marks with their German names. (4 marks)

48. Explain what reading in chunks means and why it helps. (2 marks)

49. Write the seven days of the week in German in order, starting with Monday. (4 marks)

50. Write the German words with der, die or das for: thunderstorm, candle. (2 marks)

51. Write the German words with der, die or das for: cupboard or wardrobe, weather, back, sugar, child. (5 marks)

52. Write the German words with der, die or das for: sofa, bathroom, potato, milk, finger. (5 marks)

53. Write a short weather report in German with a greeting, weather and a goodbye. (4 marks)

54. Write the German words with der, die or das for: present, aunt, mango. (3 marks)

55. Write the German words with der, die or das for: cloud, cake, toe. (3 marks)

56. Write the German words with der, die or das for: onion, parents, ear. (3 marks)

57. Write the ordinal numbers for first, second and third in German. (3 marks)

58. Write your own Elfchen about a birthday. Check that it has 11 words. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
GERMAN — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #20 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. D — on Mondays
   Montags means on Mondays, or every Monday.

2. C — radio
   das Radio means radio.

3. A — garden
   der Garten means garden.

4. A — Mittwoch
   After Dienstag comes Mittwoch.

5. D — day
   der Tag means day.

6. C — yesterday
   gestern means yesterday.

7. A — What do you like to eat?
   was = what, isst = eat, gern = with pleasure.

8. B — milk
   die Milch means milk.

9. D — Ich esse gern Bananen.
   gern shows you like doing it.

10. D — sometimes
   manchmal means sometimes.

11. B — rain
   der Regen means rain.

12. C — What is your name?
   Wie heißt du? means What is your name?.

13. A — thank you
   Danke means thank you.

14. B — Haus
   The letters au sound like ow.

15. B — child
   das Kind means child.

16. D — Go down and stop
   A full stop (der Punkt) tells us to end the sentence with a falling voice.

17. A — das
   It is das Schlafzimmer, so the little word is das.

18. C — 6
   Montag, Dienstag, Donnerstag, Freitag, Samstag and Sonntag. Only Mittwoch does not.

19. A — week
   die Woche means week.

20. A — together
   zusammen means together.

21. C — zwanzig
   20 in German is zwanzig.

22. D — to see
   We see with our eyes.

23. B — shoulder
   die Schulter means shoulder.

24. D — wind
   der Wind means wind.

25. B — What is she doing?
   was macht sie means what does she do.

26. C — in
   in in German is in.

27. B — Nouns
   All German nouns begin with capital letters.

28. C — Gute Nacht
   good night in German is Gute Nacht.

29. C — die Mütter
   The plural of die Mutter is die Mütter.

30. B — die Türen
   The plural of die Tür is die Türen.

31. D — Der Tisch ist in der Küche.
   Küche is a die word: in der Küche, with a capital K.

32. A — der
   It is der Topf, so the little word is der.

33. A — der Montag
   Monday in German is der Montag.

34. C — duschen
   to have a shower in German is duschen.

35. B — der Tag
   day in German is der Tag.

36. D — der Geburtstag
   birthday in German is der Geburtstag.

37. A — eighth
   der achte means eighth.

38. A — das Ei
   egg in German is das Ei.

39. D — der Kopf
   head in German is der Kopf.

40. A — der
   It is der Bauch, so the little word is der.

SECTION B
----
41. (4 marks)
   Answer: die Party, der Fuß, der Kopf, die Tochter.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (4 marks).

42. (2 marks)
   Answer: They give vitamins and energy; they help us to stay healthy.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each reason.

43. (2 marks)
   Answer: Freitag.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the correct word and 1 mark for the capital letter.

44. (3 marks)
   Answer: der Bauch, der Apfel, der Käse.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (3 marks).

45. (3 marks)
   Answer: der Zucker, das Kind, das Sofa.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (3 marks).

46. (4 marks)
   Answer: der Mund and die Nase.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word and 1 mark for each article.

47. (4 marks)
   Answer: . der Punkt, , das Komma, ? das Fragezeichen, ! das Ausrufezeichen.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each mark with its name.

48. (2 marks)
   Answer: It means reading groups of words together, so your reading sounds smooth.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the meaning and 1 mark for the reason.

49. (4 marks)
   Answer: Montag, Dienstag, Mittwoch, Donnerstag, Freitag, Samstag, Sonntag.
   Working / marking points: 4 marks for all seven correct; lose 1 mark for every two errors.

50. (2 marks)
   Answer: das Gewitter, die Kerze.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (2 marks).

51. (5 marks)
   Answer: der Schrank, das Wetter, der Rücken, der Zucker, das Kind.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (5 marks).

52. (5 marks)
   Answer: das Sofa, das Badezimmer, die Kartoffel, die Milch, der Finger.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (5 marks).

53. (4 marks)
   Answer: For example: Guten Morgen! Heute ist es sonnig und warm. Es ist nicht windig. Tschüss!
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the greeting, 1 mark for weather sentences, 1 mark for spelling, 1 mark for the goodbye.

54. (3 marks)
   Answer: das Geschenk, die Tante, die Mango.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (3 marks).

55. (3 marks)
   Answer: die Wolke, der Kuchen, der Zeh.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (3 marks).

56. (3 marks)
   Answer: die Zwiebel, die Eltern, das Ohr.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (3 marks).

57. (3 marks)
   Answer: der erste, der zweite, der dritte.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

58. (4 marks)
   Answer: For example: Kuchen / Süße Kerzen / Wir singen zusammen / Ich bin heute zehn / Danke!
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the 1-2-3-4-1 pattern, 1 mark for spelling, 1 mark for capital letters, 1 mark for meaning.
